system.description: You learn to amplify every sensation an enemy feels from long lasting damage. As a Bonus action, select one creature you can see within 60 feet of you, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, for the next minute, damage they take as the result of a Condition they have, is increased by +2, for each rank they have. This increases to +4 at 15th level.
